item.title: WATCH: Countdown to the WNBA Draft
item.summary: Three of the biggest prospects, Lauren Betts, Kiki Rice and Gabriela Jaquez, are fresh off their historic national championship with UCLA and join “GMA” live to talk about the big night.

item.title: WATCH: Lawmakers deliver remarks at Holocaust remembrance ceremony
item.summary: House Speaker Mike Johnson and Senate Minority Leader Chuck Schumer were among the lawmakers who delivered remarks at a Holocaust remembrance ceremony on Capitol Hill on Tuesday.

item.title: Doctor faces manslaughter charge for allegedly removing wrong organ during surgery
item.summary: A grand jury indicted a Florida doctor on manslaughter charges for allegedly removing a patient’s liver, instead of his spleen, during a 2024 surgery

item.title: WATCH: Doctor delivers 2 sets of twins on his 34th birthday
item.summary: A Pennsylvania doctor delivered two sets of twins on April 8, which happened to be his 34th birthday.

item.title: WATCH: Pilot speaks out after crash landing
item.summary: A small plane landed on a busy Phoenix street, with officials calling it a miracle that no one was seriously injured in the plane or on the ground.

item.title: WATCH: Humanoid robot chasing wild boars in Poland goes viral
item.summary: Video of a humanoid robot chasing wild boars out of a Warsaw neighborhood and into the woods — and then waving goodbye — has gone viral in Poland.

item.summary: An Iowa man invented a submarine for his parrot so that he didn't have to leave the bird alone during a trip to the Bahamas.

item.summary: The request is for those who were previously not covered by President Donald Trump’s sweeping Day 1 clemency grants.
